# Python API

Back to the [README](../README.md) · [usage guide](USAGE.md) · [parameter reference](PARAMETERS.md) · [documentation index](README.md).

`amgeo_sd` is a library as well as a command line: everything `make median`, `make dbscan` and `make plot-*` do is a function you can call. Each page below documents one sub-package. **Every parameter of every public function has a type, a default and a description**; a test fails when a parameter is added without one, and these pages are regenerated from the docstrings by `make docs`.

| Page | Module | Use it to |
|---|---|---|
| [Data model](api/models.md) | `amgeo_sd.models` | `Beam` and `Scan`: what every function below passes around. |
| [Reading and writing data](api/io.md) | `amgeo_sd.io` | fitacf / fitacf++ files in and out, DataFrames, scans. |
| [Median-filter model](api/filters.md) | `amgeo_sd.filters` | The weighted 3 x 3 x 3 median filter and its flags. |
| [DBSCAN / GMM model](api/clustering.md) | `amgeo_sd.clustering` | Cluster the raw echoes of each beam. |
| [Ribiero cluster rule](api/scatter.md) | `amgeo_sd.scatter` | Ionospheric or ground scatter from a cluster's speed. |
| [Radar geometry](api/geo.md) | `amgeo_sd.geo` | Field of view: geographic latitude / longitude of every gate. |
| [Plotting](api/plotting.md) | `amgeo_sd.plotting` | Range-time (RTI) and field-of-view figures. |
| [Pipelines](api/pipelines.md) | `amgeo_sd.pipelines` | Whole workflows: files in, fitacf++ and figures out. |
| [NetCDF export](api/export.md) | `amgeo_sd.export` | Scans to an xarray Dataset / `.pp.nc`, run provenance files. |
| [Settings](api/config.md) | `amgeo_sd.config` | The TOML settings objects behind `--config`. |

## Conventions

- **Times** are naive `datetime` objects in UTC.
- A **beam** (`Beam`) is one integration period in one look direction, a **scan** (`Scan`) the beams that sweep the field of view once. Per-echo arrays (`slist`, `v`, `w_l`, `p_l`, `gflg`, ...) hold only gates with scatter.
- **Units**: velocity `v` and spectral width `w_l` in m/s, power `p_l` in dB, range gates are 0-based indices, distances in km, angles in degrees.
- A **DataFrame** (from `scans_to_dataframe`, `load_frame`) has one row per echo: `time`, `scnum` (scan), `sbnum` (beam slot in the scan), `bmnum`, `slist` (range gate), the beam header values (`tfreq`, `nrang`, `frang`, `rsep`, ...) and the echo values (`v`, `w_l`, `p_l`, `gflg`, plus `gflg_kde`, `v_mad`, `cluster_tag`, ... for fitacf++). Geolocation is not in the table: use `radar_fov`.
- The settings classes (`Dbscan`, `Median`, ...) are the same objects that `--config` fills; their fields are in the [parameter reference](PARAMETERS.md).

## Common workflows

The snippets run from the project root on the test data (`make data-unpack`); a test executes them.

**Read, median-filter, count**

```python
from datetime import datetime
from amgeo_sd.io import FitacfReader, expand_paths, scans_to_dataframe
from amgeo_sd.filters import MedianFilter

files = expand_paths(["tests/data/bks_20250208"])        # a directory is searched for fitacf files
reader = FitacfReader("bks", datetime(2025, 2, 8, 3), datetime(2025, 2, 8, 3, 30), files=files)
scans = reader.scans()                                   # list[Scan]; fitacf 2.0, 2.5 and 3.0 are read alike
filtered = MedianFilter(thresh=0.6, kde=False, cluster=False).filter_scans(scans)   # drops the first and last scan
raw, kept = scans_to_dataframe(scans), scans_to_dataframe(filtered)
print(f"{len(scans)} scans, {len(raw)} raw echoes, {len(kept)} after the median filter")
```

**Run the median model, read the result, plot a range-time panel**

```python
from datetime import datetime
from amgeo_sd.io import expand_paths, load_frame
from amgeo_sd.pipelines import run_median_filter
from amgeo_sd.plotting import plot_rti

out = run_median_filter(
    "bks", datetime(2025, 2, 8, 3), datetime(2025, 2, 8, 3, 30), files=expand_paths(["tests/data/bks_20250208"]),
    out_base="data/outputs/api-example", sim_id="median", kde=False, cluster=False, write_fitacf=False,
)
frame, info = load_frame([out["nc_file"]])               # pandas DataFrame, one row per echo
plot_rti(frame, beam=12, params=["v", "gflg_conv"], path="data/outputs/api-example/rti.png", rad="bks")
```

**Run the DBSCAN model and draw a map**

```python
from datetime import datetime
from amgeo_sd.config import Dbscan
from amgeo_sd.io import expand_paths, load_frame
from amgeo_sd.pipelines import run_dbscan_model
from amgeo_sd.plotting import plot_fan

out = run_dbscan_model(
    "bks", datetime(2025, 2, 8, 3), datetime(2025, 2, 8, 3, 30), files=expand_paths(["tests/data/bks_20250208"]),
    params=Dbscan(eps=2, min_samples=8), out_base="data/outputs/api-example", sim_id="dbscan", write_fitacf=False,
)
print(out["n_clusters"], "clusters,", round(100 * out["fraction_noise"], 1), "% noise")
frame, info = load_frame([out["nc_file"]])
plot_fan(frame, "bks", datetime(2025, 2, 8, 3, 10), params=["v", "gflg_ribiero"], path="data/outputs/api-example/fan.png")
```

## Which function for what

| I want to ... | Call |
|---|---|
| read fitacf files of a radar and time window | [`FitacfReader`](api/io.md#fitacfreader) |
| read one file as plain records | [`read_fitacf_file`](api/io.md#read_fitacf_file) |
| get a table of echoes | [`scans_to_dataframe`](api/io.md#scans_to_dataframe), [`load_frame`](api/io.md#load_frame) |
| clean scans with the median filter | [`MedianFilter`](api/filters.md#medianfilter) |
| label raw echoes with DBSCAN / GMM clusters | [`cluster_scans`](api/clustering.md#cluster_scans) |
| run a whole model and write fitacf++ files | [`run_median_filter`](api/pipelines.md#run_median_filter), [`run_dbscan_model`](api/pipelines.md#run_dbscan_model) |
| read a `.pp.nc` file back | [`read_fitacfpp_nc`](api/io.md#read_fitacfpp_nc) |
| plot range-time or a map | [`plot_rti`](api/plotting.md#plot_rti), [`plot_fan`](api/plotting.md#plot_fan) |
| geolocate the gates of a radar | [`radar_fov`](api/geo.md#radar_fov) |
